<entry id="J00496">
<head-word>יַעֲקֹב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<italic>Jacob</italic>, 1) J.</definition>
<notes>, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> J. the patriarch. Ber. 13
<sup>a</sup> לא שיעקר י' וכ' not that the name Jacob should be entirely abandoned, but &c., v. 
<xref rid="I00660">טָפֵל</xref>. Gen. R. s. 1; a. v. fr.—2) R. J., name of a Tannai (or of several Tannaim, v. Fr. Darkhe Mish. p. 202). Ab. IV, 16. Pes. 84
<sup>a</sup>; Snh. 63
<sup>b</sup>, a. e., v. שֵׁם. Ḥull. 45
<sup>b</sup>.—Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup> ר' י' בן קרשי; Y. Pes. X, beg. 37
<sup>b</sup> ר' י' בן קורשיי.—3) R. J., name of many Amoraim, esp. a) R. J. of K’far Nibburaya. Y. Bicc. III, 65
<sup>d</sup> top, a. fr., v. נִבּוּרַיָּא.—b) R. J. b. Idi. Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Shek. II, 47
<sup>a</sup> top; Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Midr. Sam. ch. XIX; Yeb. 96
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—V. Fr. M’bo p. 104
<sup>a</sup>, sq.—4) J. the bathing master (?). Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>c</sup> top עד י' תרמוסרא היה לובשן until he came to the station of J. &c. he kept the T’fillin on; Pesik. R. s. 22 עד יעקר תורמוסא.—5) J. of K’far Sikhnaya, a disciple of Jesus of Nazareth. Ab. Zar. 17
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.; v. סִכְנַיָּא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00497">
<head-word>יַעַר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>forest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 32
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XIX, 5) ומה י' וכ' when in the case of unintentional homicide in the forest where each entered of his own accord &c.; Sifré Deut. 182 מה י' רשות וכ' as in the case … in the forest, both had a right to enter. Cant. R. to III, 4, v. יְאוֹר; a. fr.—[יער, יאר = עור, אור, 
<italic>to break forth</italic>, applied to vegetation, water-course and light (cmp. נָהָר a. נְהוֹרָא); cmp. יְאוֹר a. Sam. יאר Gen. I, 11 for h. דשא.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00498">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>,

<plural-form>Pl. יַעְרֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Prov. XXIV, 31 (h. text קמשונים).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00500">
<head-word>יָפֶה</head-word>
<head-word>יָפָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; pl. יָפִין, יָפוֹת 
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key> יפי 
<italic>to join</italic>,
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00796"> cmp. אוֹף I</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> a. יפע)</xref></language-reference> [
<italic>well-joined</italic>, cmp. כָּשֵׁר, יָאֶה a. Arab.</definition>
<notes>
<italic>wafa</italic>,] </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>appropriate; strong, healthy; handsome, beautiful, fine</italic> (of build); 
<italic>auspicious</italic>; (adv.) 
<italic>well, right</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. 66
<sup>b</sup> (an ambiguous expression, v. מוּם) עד שתראי מום י' שביך וכ' until thou showest to R. … ‘an appropriate blemish’ (or ‘something handsome’) in thee; י' קורין וכ' it was nice (appropriate) that they named her 
<italic>lakhlukhith</italic> (aversion). Ber. 4
<sup>a</sup> י' דנתי have I well argued (was I right)?; י' חייבתי was I right in convicting?—Ib. 34
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. רובן קשה ומיעוטן י' a large dose of them is injurious, a small one wholesome (or becoming). Ib. 39
<sup>a</sup> י' ללב וטוב וכ' wholesome for the heart, and good &c. Ib. 56
<sup>b</sup> י' לו or י' is an auspicious dream; a. v. fr.—דעת יָפָה, v. דַּעַת.—יָדַיִם יָפוֹת 
<italic>skilled hands</italic> for grabbing. Pes. 89
<sup>b</sup> members of a Passover party שהיו ידיו של אחד מהן י' one of whom is extremely quick (in taking and eating); Tosef. ib. VII, 10 רפות ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.). Sifra K’dosh. Par. 1, ch. III אפי' בריא אפי' ידיו י' even if (among the poor coming for their share in the harvest) he (who insists on grabbing instead of distributing) is very strong, very skillful.—כֹּחַ יָפֶה 
<italic>a strong legal right, privilege, prerogative</italic>. Kidd. 21
<sup>a</sup> י' כחו ליגאל לעולם the privilege of its redemption remains unimpaired forever (up to the jubilee year); י' … בשנה שנייה the privilege of redemption in the second year is unimpaired; opp. הורע כחו. Shebu. 48
<sup>a</sup> י' כח הבן וכ' the son’s prerogative is stronger (more extended) than that of his deceased father was; Ḥull. 49
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Ohol. XVIII, 6; Zab. III, 1, v. כֹּחַ.—יְפַת תֹּאַר 
<italic>handsome woman</italic>, esp. (ref. to Deut. XXI, 10 sq.) 
<italic>a gentile captive</italic> with whom the captor has had intercourse before deciding on converting and making her his legitimate wife. Kidd. 21
<sup>b</sup> כהן מהו בי' ת' is a priest permitted to marry a gentile captive?—Snh. 21
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 107
<sup>a</sup> כל הנושא י' ת' וכ' he who marries a gentile captive will have a rebellious son (ref. to Deut. l. c. a. ib. 18 sq.); 
<pgbrk id="pg586" />a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. טוֹב) 
<italic>worth, valued</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. VIII, 3 (79
<sup>b</sup>) שמין אותה כמה היא יָפָה וכ' (Mish. … אותן … הן יָפִין) we assess the land how much it is worth with the fruits and how much without. Ib. III, 7; a. fr.—Denom.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00501">
<head-word>יִפָּה, </head-word>
<head-word>יִיפָּה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to beautify; to make pleasant, popular</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Gen. R. s. 39, beg. (ref. to Ps. XLV, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> ליַפּוֹתָיךְ בעולם to make thee popular in the world.</definition>
<notes> Ned. IX, 10 יִיפּוּהָ they improved her appearance. Ber. 43
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Koh. III, 11) שי' הקב"ה אומנתו בפני כל וא' א' Ms. M. (differ. in ed.), v. אוּמָנוּת.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְיוּפֶּה 
<italic>adorned, elaborate</italic>. Cant. R. to I, 1 נמצא מי' ומרובה וכ' was Solomon’s palace more elaborate and extensive than the Temple?—2) 
<italic>to improve</italic> (land). Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> top קצר ליַיפּוֹת וכ' he cut the grass for the sake of improving the land. Ib. חייב משום מְיַיפֶּה וכ' he is guilty of the offence of improving the land on the Sabbath. Pesik. S’liḥoth, p. 166
<sup>a</sup> יַפֵּה כחך improve thy strength (by practicing).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with כח) 
<italic>to strengthen one’s rights, to confer prerogatives</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. VII, 2 ליַיפּוֹת כחו של מוכר to give the seller the prerogative. Y. ib. VIII, 16
<sup>a</sup> top יִיפִּיתָה כחה בנכסי האם thou hast (the Law has) given her a prerogative with reference to her mother’s property; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>*.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>יוּפָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, with כח, 
<italic>to be made stronger</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Peah VI, 6 [read:] יופה כחו של וכ' (Ms. M. ייפיה, ed. יופי) the prerogative of the owner has been made firmer, opp. הורע.—
<italic>Part.</italic> מְיוּפֶּה (v. supra). Y. Gitt. II, beg. 44
<sup>a</sup> חתימה … כחו מי' by two persons testifying to the signature her case is improved.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְיַפֶּה, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְיַפֶּה </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become handsome</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 23
<sup>b</sup> תִּתְיַיפִּי חנה Hannah, grow handsome, ונִתְיַיפְּתָה Ms. M. (ed. … פָּת) and she did &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be praised</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 59 נִתְיַיפִּיתָ וכ' thou (Abraham) hast been praised among the angels &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00502">
<head-word>יָפוֹ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. pl.</pos>
<italic>Japho</italic> (
<italic>Joppa</italic>), the harbor of Jerusalem.</definition>
<notes> Pirké d’R. El. ch. X. Yalk. Is. 334 עד שיחיה די' to the excavations of the harbor of J.; Cant. R. to VII, 5 ריפע (corr. acc.); v. יָקַב. Ex. R. s. 43 ר'חייא … די' (some ed. דיָפוֹא) R. Ḥ. … of J.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00503">
<head-word>יִפּוּי, </head-word>
<head-word>יִיפּוּי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>excellence, distinction</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="J00504">
<head-word>*, </head-word>
<head-word>*יַפַּח</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נפח) 
<italic>blowing up</italic> (of cheeks).</definition>
<notes> Snh. 18
<sup>b</sup> (as a rule for appointing the Spring month, v. אָבִיב) אם קידום … י' בלועך נפיק לקיבליה וכ' (Ms. M. רפח מלועך, corr. acc.; oth. Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when the East wind is ever so strong, and a blow out of thy cheek goes out to meet it (i.e. if a person feels the warmth of thy breath blown against the East wind),—such is Adar (and no Adar Sheni is to be intercalated); Y. ib. I, 18
<sup>c</sup> bot. פה בלועה יפיק וכ' (read: פח בלועך); Y. R. Hash. I, 58
<sup>b</sup> top פוח לוחיך ופוק וכ' blow up thy cheek &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<definition> (יָפֶה) 
<italic>beauty, excellence</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 9
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Gen. IX, 27) יָפְיוּתוֹ של יפת תהא וכ' (not יהא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the beauty of Japheth (Greek language) shall reside in the tents of Shem (ref. to the Greek Bible translation); Yalk. Gen. 61 יוֹפְיוּתוֹ.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00511">
<head-word>יָפַע</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. יָפֶה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , 
<italic>Hif.</italic> הוֹפִיעַ </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to join, arrive</italic> (cmp. אָתָא), 
<italic>to come forth, appear</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 12 כל א' וא' ה' בזמנו each (part of creation) came forth in its due time (though all were created at once).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring, transfer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 38
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXXIII, 2) מפארן ה' ממונם וכ' from (what occurred at) Paran (the gentiles refusing to receive the Law) he (the Lord) transferred their wealth to Israel.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring about, bring to light, reveal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 90; Yalk. ib. 148 (play on צ̇פ̇נ̇ת̇ פ̇ע̇נ̇ח̇) צפ̇ונ̇ות̇ הופ̇יע̇ ונ̇ח̇ות וכ' he reveals secrets, and it is easy to him to tell them; צ̇פ̇ונ̇ות̇ הופיע̇ בדעת מנ̇יח̇ וכ' he brings secret things to light through his intelligence; with them he sets mankind at ease. Macc. 23
<sup>b</sup>; Gen. R. s. 85 בג' מקומות ה' רוה"ק on three occasions did the holy spirit reveal (the true state of affairs); (oth. opin. v. פּוּעַ). Koh. R. to VII, 1 (play on פועה, Ex. I, 15) שהוֹפִיעָה את מעשה אחיה she (Miriam) brought about what happened to her brother (she was the cause of Moses’ peculiar career).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lift up, raise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 1 (play on פועה, v. supra) שהופיעה את ישראל וכ' she (Miriam) lifted Israel up to God.—ה' פנים כנגד 
<italic>to lift one’s face up against, to have the courage to rebuke</italic>. Ib. שהופיעה פ' … וזקפה וכ' she lifted her face up against Pharaoh and turned her nose up against him (in angry rebuke). Ib. שה' פ' כנגד אביה she dared to reprove her father. Y. B. Kam. IV, 4
<sup>b</sup> top.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<definition>,

<entry id="J00513">
<head-word>יֶפֶת</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<italic>Japheth</italic>, one of the sons of Noah, progenitor of the Aryan races (Greeks, Persians &c.).</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 36 (ref. to Gen. IX, 27) זה כורש that is Cyrus (the Persians). Ib. יהיו … בלשונו של י' the words of the Law shall be recited in the language of J. (Greek). Pesik. R. s. 35 כורש … שהוא מזרעו של י' Cyrus … who is a descendant of J. Meg. 9
<sup>b</sup>, v. יָפְיוּת; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00514">
<head-word>יִפְתָּח</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<italic>Jephthah</italic>, the Judge.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 25
<sup>b</sup> י' בדורו כשמואל וכ' the authority of a J. in his days must be respected as that of a Samuel in his; Tosef. ib. II (I), 3 בית דינו של י'. Gen. R. s. 60; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00515">
<head-word>יָצָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go forth; to rise</italic> (of the sun); 
<italic>to go out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 39 אֵצֵא ויהיו וכ' I shall leave (my father’s house), and they may desecrate &c. Ib. י' לו מוניטון a medal was issued in his memory, v. מוֹנִיטוֹן. Ib. s. 6 בשעה שהוא יוצא when he (the sun) rises; בשעה שהיא יוֹצֵאת when she (the moon) rises. Snh. 52
<sup>a</sup> ארור שיָצָאת זו מחלציו (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) cursed is he from whose loins this woman went forth.—Sabb. V, 1 במה … יוֹצְאָה what is an animal permitted to wear on going out (on the Sabbath)? Ib. VI, 1 לא תֵצֵא וכ' a woman must not wear on going out &c.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>

<italic>the inclination to do good;</italic> (personified)

<italic>the evil inclination, worldly desires</italic>; (personified) 
<italic>the tempter</italic>. Ber. 61

<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Ps. 842 שלא ישלוט בך יצה"ר that temptation may have no power over thee. Succ. 52
<sup>a </sup>… לעתיד מביאו ליצה"ר וכ' in the days to come the Lord shall bring the Tempter and slaughter him &c. Gen. R. s. 22 מפנק את יִצְרוֹ who indulges the senses. Ib. אם בא יִצְרְךָ להשחיקך when thy inclination (Tempter) comes to lead thee to amusement. Cant. R. to VII, 8 י' ע"ז the passion for idolatry, י' זנות the passion of lust. Ab. IV, 1 הכובש את יצרו who conquers his inclination; a. v. fr. [Yoma 69

<plural-form>Pl. יְצָרִים</plural-form>. Ber. 61
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to וייצר, Gen. II, 7, v. יְצִירָה) שני י' וכ' two natures, the good and the evil. Cant. R. l. c. שני י' ברא וכ' two passions did God create in this world, v. supra. Snh. 105
<sup>a</sup> יסרו יצריכם chasten your passions; Yalk. Is. 302.—[יְצָרִים 
<italic>moulds</italic>, v. יְצִירִין.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>Hof</italic>.) when fire has been set; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note]. Ib. 68

<sup>b</sup> משתצית בו את האור (Ms. M. משיצית האור, Ms. R. 1 משתיצת); Sot. 15

<sup>a</sup>, v. אַגָּם. Y. B. Kam. II, 3
<sup>a</sup> במַצִּית את האור וכ' setting fire to each ear 
<pgbrk id="pg591" />of corn separately. Bab. ib. 22
<sup>b</sup> בשה' בגופו וכ' when he set fire to the body of the slave; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>a</sup> היא קיימא לה בי' כחץ she can feel it whether the emission is permeating &c. Sifré Deut. 42 יוֹרֶה שמתכון … יורד וכ' the rain is called 
<italic>yoreh</italic> (shooting), for it is aimed at the earth with deliberation, and does not come down in a storm; Taan. 6
<sup>a</sup> יורה שיורד בנחת.—2) 
<italic>to throw, shoot</italic>. Yalk. Gen. 133 לִירוֹת בב' ידיו to throw spears with both hands; v. infra.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>

<senses>

<definition>

<italic>yoreh</italic>, v. supra) pervades and satisfies the earth and gives her drink down to the deep (Taan. l. c., Yalk. Deut. 863 only שמַרְוֶה).—[Y. Maasr. I, 49

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<sup>a</sup> bot. יורו במשיח וכ' (read: הורו or יָירוּ, 
<italic>Kal</italic>). Yalk. Gen. l. c. (fr. Midr. Vayisu) היה מוֹרֶה חניתית וכ' he threw spears with both hands &c. Ex. R. s. 3 (ref. to והיריתיך, Ex. IV, 12) מורה אני וכ' I shall shoot my words into thy mouth like an arrow; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to point out, to direct, teach, instruct; to decide</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> כל המוֹרֶה הלכה בפני וכ' whoever decides a law-point in the presence of his teacher. Ab. V, 8 המוֹרִים בתורה וכ' who decide in religious matters against the law (by means of sophistry). Sabb. 19

<entry id="J00675">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sit down, rest; to dwell, remain; to be inactive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Macc. III, 15 כל חיוֹשֵׁב ולא עבר וכ' whoever is inactive and commits no sin, i.e. omits to do wrong; Kidd. 39
<sup>b</sup>.—Erub. 100
<sup>a</sup> שֵׁב ואל תעשה עדיף ‘sit and do nothing’, i.e. not to act in doubtful cases, is better, opp. קום ועשה. Ber. 20
<sup>a</sup> שב ואל תעשה שאני with an omission it is different. Tosef. Snh. VII, 8 ולא יֵשְׁבוּ … להם שֵׁבוּ and they must not sit down until he says to them, Be seated; Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Bicc. III, 65
<sup>c</sup> bot.—Y. Dem. II, 23
<sup>a</sup> top שי' בישיבח who has a seat in the scholars’ meetings. Snh. 10
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. II, 1 אחד אומר לֵישֵׁב if one is in favor of sitting (holding deliberation in court). Zeb. II, 1 יוֹשֵׁב in a sitting position. Ber. 28
<sup>b</sup> מיוֹשְׁבֵי בה"מ one of the attendants at college, יושבי קרנות those placed at street corners (traders, idlers). Gen. R. s 75 יושבי קרנות (corr. קרונות) sitting in chariots; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be settled</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="J00350">יִישּׁוּב</xref>), 
<italic>be inhabited</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 4 הגבעה … יוֹשְׁבִים Gibeah and Kiryath Jearim were settled at the same time.—Erub. 86
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ps. LXI, 8) אימתי יושב עולם לפני וכ' (Rashi a. Ar. יֵשֵׁב) when is the world settled (evenly balanced) before God? When kindness and truth are appointed to guard it (differ. in Rashi; v. infra).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>יִשֵּׁב, יִישֵּׁב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to settle, put in place, to arrange evenly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. XII, beg. 13
<sup>c</sup> הבנאי י' את האבן וכ' the builder that placed a stone on top of the row (v. דִּימוֹס I). Ib.
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Pes. VIII, 33
<sup>b</sup> top מפני שהוא כמְיַישֵּׁב בידו because it is like settling the web with one’s own hand. Lev. R. s. 37 [read:] יָשַׁב וְיִ' להם סבלותם וכ' he sat down (as a judge) and arranged their burdens in proper proportions between man and woman. Ib. אתה עתיד ליַישֵּׁב וכ' thou art designated to settle and explain to my children their vows &c. Ex. R. s. 31 (ref. to Ps. LXI, 8, v. supra) יַשֵּׁב עולמך make thy world evenly balanced (as to property); Tanḥ. Mishp. 9 תיישר עולמך בשוה (read: תְּיַישֵּׁב). Ex. R. s. 52 לא היו יודעין ליַישְּׁבוֹ they knew not how to put its parts together; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to set the mind at ease, to quiet</italic>. Sabb. 87
<sup>a</sup> דברים שמְיַישְּׁבִין לבו וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שמושכין) words which quiet the mind of man &c.; Gen. R. s. 80 דברים שמְיַישְּׁבִים את הלב. Y. Pes. V, end, 32
<sup>d</sup> (expl. וישב, II Sam. VII, 18) וַיַישֶּׁב עצמו לתפלה he quieted his mind for prayer; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to settle, cultivate, populate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 58
<sup>b </sup>… עתיד להחזירו וליַישְּׁבוֹ Ms. M. (ed. ליִישּׁוּבוֹ) the Lord will again people it. Sot. 22
<sup>a</sup> מְיַישְּׁבֵי עולם cultivators of the world.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְיוּשָּׁב, f. מְיוּשֶּׁבֶת a) 
<italic>seated</italic>. Meg. 21
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Gitt. VII, 48
<sup>d</sup> top; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>sedate, at ease</italic>. Y. Ber. IV, 8
<sup>b</sup> bot. לבו מי' his mind is at ease (about his animal); Bab. ib. 30
<sup>a</sup> לפי שאין דעתו מי' עליו because his mind is not at ease without it. Sifré Num. 131 היה … בקי ומי' the polemarch was experienced and cool-headed; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוֹשִׁיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to seat, place, appoint; to settle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 38
<sup>a</sup> sq.; Tosef. ib. II, 7 במקומך יוֹשִׁיבוּךָ people will finally seat thee in the place which thou deservest. Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 17 (among superstitious practices) חמוֹשֶׁבֶת אפרוחים (ו)אמרה איני מוֹשַׁבְתָּן וכ' a woman who sets hens to brood and says I will not set them except in pairs (v. ed. Zuck. note). Snh. IV, 4 מוֹשִׁיבִין אותו וכ' a seat is assigned to him in the third row. Macc. 10
<sup>a</sup> ואין מוֹשִׁיבִין אותם וכ' and we must not lay them out except on a river; (Tosef. ib. III (II), 8 בונין).—Tosef. l. c. מביאין … ומושיבין וכ' other people are imported and settled in their place. B. Kam. 16
<sup>b</sup> bot. הוֹשִׁיבוּ ישיבה וכ' they held scholars’ meetings by his grave. Snh. 17
<sup>a</sup> אין מושיבין בסנהדרי וכ' none can be appointed members of the Sanhedrin except &c.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>

<number>—2)</number>

<entry id="J00681">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (יָשַׁב) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>settlement, inhabited land</italic>, opp. מדבר or ים; 
<italic>cultivation, social world, civilization; public welfare</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to I, 15; Ruth. R. to I, 17 אם אין 
<pgbrk id="pg600" />אדם מתקן ביי' וכ' if man does not prepare provision in the inhabited settlement (this world), what will he have to eat in the desert (the hereafter)?—Y. B. Kam. V, end, 5
<sup>a</sup>, v. אָוָוז. Ber. 31
<sup>a</sup>, v. יָשַׁב. Ib. 58
<sup>b</sup> הרואה בתי … ביִשּׁוּבָן he who sees Israelitish places in their inhabitable condition (restoration), opp. בחורבנן. Ib. עתיד הקב"ה להחזירו ליִשּׁוּבוֹ the Lord will restore it again. Tam. 29
<sup>b</sup>; B. Kam. 80
<sup>b</sup> משום י' א"י in order to maintain the cultivation of Palestine. Y. B. Bath. II, end, 13
<sup>c</sup> י' עולם בבורות social welfare depends on wells; באילנות on trees. Kidd. I, 10 אינו מן הי' does not belong to the civilized world. Gen. R. s. 35 בני אדם של י' civilized (polite) people; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with or without דעת) 
<italic>ease of mind, calmness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. s. 19 בי' הדעת באת עליו she came to him with deliberation (logical arguments). Y. Ned. I, 36
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Num. R. s. 10 מתיך י' (הדעת) in a calm state of mind, opp. אקפדה; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00689">
<head-word>יְשִׁיבָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (יָשַׁב) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>sitting, rest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥag. 15
<sup>a </sup>… למעלה לא עמידה ולא י' וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) on high there is no standing up and no sitting down (effort and rest), no emulation &c. Yoma 69
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. אין י' בעזרה none were allowed to sit down in the Temple court. Gen. R. s. 38, a. fr. כל מקום שאתח מוצא י' וכ' wherever you find sitting (retirement, use of the word ישב) recorded in the Bible, there Satan leaps forth (trouble arises). Yeb. 106
<sup>a</sup> יְשִׁיבָתָהּ זו היא עמידתה this her sitting is to her a getting up (sitting up is to her a great effort; oth. expl.: her being left seated, is her erection, i.e. her failure to be married to the 
<italic>yabam</italic> is a benefit to her); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>settlement, dwelling</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 37
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. יְרוּשָּׁה. Keth. 110
<sup>b</sup> יְשִׁיבַת כרכים קשה living in large cities is a hardship. Sabb. 10
<sup>b</sup> עיר שיְשִׁיבָתָהּ קרובה a town of recent settlement; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>scholars’ session, council, academy; court</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 28
<sup>b</sup> זקן ויושב בי' an elder and member of council. Ib. לא פרשה י' מהם they (our early ancestors) were never without council (a representative body). Pes. 119
<sup>a</sup> top המכיר … בי' who knows his colleague’s place in meetings; … המקבל בי' who greets his colleague in meetings with kindness. Ber. 57
<sup>a</sup> ראש י' presiding officer. Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>d</sup> top ומינו את ר"א … בי' they elected R. El. … (president) in regular session. Ib. הושיבו … בי' they installed him as president. B. Bath. 120
<sup>a</sup> בי' הלך וכ' in court or college give the preference to learning, in social entertainment to age; a. fr.—י' של מעלה divine court. B. Mets. 86
<sup>a</sup> נתבקש בי' של מ' has been summoned before divine justice (is dead); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְשִׁיבוֹת</plural-form>. Koh. R. to I, 8 אפשר שהי' הללו טועות וכ' is it possible that those colleges be lost in such futile errors; Tosef. Ḥull. II, 24 שהסיבו הללו טועים (corr. acc.; v., however, סֵיבוּ). Y. Sabb. X, 12
<sup>c</sup> bot. שימשתי את אבא עומדות מה שלא שמשת י' I have served my father at more ‘standing meetings’ (standing up as an Amora) than you have served at college sessions; Y. Ḥag. III, beg. 78
<sup>d</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
